preferWhen: Bulk code execution on whatever model omp is already configured for, when the brief is fully specified and no per-record model pin is wanted.
avoidWhen: Security-sensitive work; visual deliverables; any review that must come from a guaranteed independent family, because this record's family follows local omp configuration rather than the record. When this record is the producer, resolve modelRoles.default from ~/.omp/agent/config.yml before seating a reviewer: 'omp-configured' differs from every real family string and would otherwise fake cross-family independence.
